build_pgvector_client: build a PgvectorClient instance to connect to a PostgreSQL database with pgvector extension for vector similarity search
create_insert_vector_items: create a PgvectorClient and insert a list of VectorItems with embeddings into a named collection
test_search_similarity: test the PgvectorClient.search method to find top-k nearest neighbors by cosine distance with optional metadata filters
refactor_delete_collection: refactor the PgvectorClient.delete_collection method to delete all items matching a collection name or filter
review_upsert_documents: review the PgvectorClient.upsert method to insert or update document chunks with optional pgcrypto encryption
